name: Can I keep my existing sink when replacing countertops?

mainEntity.name: Can I keep my existing sink when replacing countertops?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases, whether you can keep your existing sink depends on its condition, type, and compatibility with your new countertop material. For undermount sinks, it's often recommended to get a new one to ensure a perfect fit and seal with the new countertop. Drop-in sinks might be easier to reuse, but our team will assess this during the consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Reusing an existing sink depends on its condition, type, and compatibility with the new countertop material.
